login.note: Manual, by a human, in this profile — always (ADR-0008). This is a GOOGLE sign-in, not a YouTube one: signing in here signs the profile into every Google property, and Google is the most likely of these sites to challenge an unfamiliar browser (device prompt, passkey, or a code).

logout.note: UNVERIFIED — not driven from this fork. This signs the profile out of ALL Google services, not just YouTube; there is no YouTube-only logout. The in-page control is the avatar menu -> 'Sign out'. Blast radius makes this worth a human's confirmation.

traps: One shared browser, no mutex. Two lanes attach to a nondeterministic tab. Run `chrome-agent goto <url>` then `chrome-agent status` before believing any read.

The readable cookies (PREF, __Secure-3PAPISID) are present when signed OUT; the meaningful ones (LOGIN_INFO, SAPISID) are HttpOnly. `ytcfg.data_.LOGGED_IN` is YouTube stating it itself — use that. (promoted 2026-09-12, from note)

A read recipe here scrapes THE CURRENT PAGE, so the homepage yields 0 items and looks like drift. Verify from a results or channel page (`chrome-agent verify` uses /results?search_query=chromium). (promoted 2026-09-12, from note)
No write verb exists for this site. Do not improvise one by driving the DOM.
Verification rule: read the artifact back from the live page. A 2xx proves nothing here, and on some of these sites neither does a 5xx.
